email.subject: Dockside Group Plumbing: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Hannah,

I checked Dockside Group Plumbing's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: it's not mobile-friendly, and there's no click-to-call button, so anyone searching for a plumber on their phone (most people, during an emergency) can't easily reach you.

On top of that, your site has no reviews shown and no listed hours, which makes it harder for new customers to trust you or know when to call.

I fix these kinds of issues for local businesses for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and how to fix it? No obligation either way.

Alex
